invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
OrderProduct.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderProduct.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
When an order is cancelled, the quantity of each product in that order must be added back to the product's stock_quantity.
The total quantity of a product across all orders must not exceed its stock_quantity at any time.
A product's stock_quantity must always be non-negative after any operation that modifies it.
An order can only be cancelled if it is in a status that allows cancellation, such as 'pending' or 'confirmed'.
Product searches and filters must return only products that match the specified criteria, including category and name.
All modifications to the database, including creating, updating, or deleting records, must be persisted atomically using a single transaction.
The sum of the quantities of products in an order must equal the total order quantity, and must not exceed the available stock of any individual product in that order.
Each order must be associated with a valid customer via the customer_id field.
A product must have a positive price and a non-negative stock_quantity.
Order cancellation must not affect products that are not part of the order being cancelled.
